api.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestCreateApi

dictionary.name: peoplehubexpensereceipt
dictionary.description: Table to store expense receipt file information and content.

dictionary.name: peoplehubexpenseclaim
dictionary.description: Table to store expense claim records

dictionary.name: peoplehubexpensepolicy
dictionary.description: A table to store expense policy rules and limits.

dictionary.name: peoplehubexpenseline

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestCreate
jsclass.description: POST { AWART, START_DATE, END_DATE, COMMENT, preview }: counts working days (dayjs, SAP holidays), checks overlaps, SAP quota and the balance minus days booked in Neptune; preview only checks, otherwise saves a DRAFT request.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestSeed
jsclass.description: Creates 3 test leave requests (Pending, Approved, Rejected) for the user who runs it, using their SAP employee from peoplehubusermap. Safe to run repeatedly (replaces the runner's SEED rows).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestDelete
jsclass.description: POST { id }: the employee deletes their own DRAFT leave request (409 when it is no longer a draft).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveConfirmationFile
jsclass.description: GET ?id=: the leave confirmation PDF of an approved request (PDF Archive), inline, for the employee who asked or a manager.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimUser
jsclass.description: Returns the current user and whether they are an expense approver (Cockpit role PeopleHubApproverClaim). Used by the app to decide what the user can see and do.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubDashboardKpi
jsclass.description: Dashboard KPI tile: returns a UI5 Integration Card (numeric header) with what waits for a decision, approved leave days and approved claims

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimSeed
jsclass.description: Creates or refreshes the expense claim training mock data: 6 claims (requester Antonio, approver Veronica), their lines and the expense policies. Safe to run repeatedly.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubTrainerParticipants
jsclass.description: Trainer mapping app: GET participants (leave roles + mapped users) with roles, mapping and SAP employee, plus SAP employees (validEmployees = Bill West and his reports) and the suggested PERNR; ?search= finds any user. Role PeopleHubTrainerTrainingME only.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestDecide
jsclass.description: POST { id, decision, comment }: a manager approves or rejects a PENDING leave request; on approve creates the PDF PeopleHubLeaveConfirmation and emails it to the employee (template PeopleHubLeaveRequestDecision).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubTrainerMappingSave
jsclass.description: Trainer mapping app: POST save / remove / automap (with preview) of peoplehubusermap rows; only Bill West and his reports can be mapped. Role PeopleHubTrainerTrainingME only; SAP read only.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimApprovalApprove
jsclass.description: Process flow PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval, approve branch: sets the claim to Approved and outputs the decision email texts.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimApprovalReject
jsclass.description: Process flow PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval, reject branch: sets the claim to Rejected (with a reason) and outputs the decision email texts.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimSend
jsclass.description: POST { claimid }: checks the claim, sets it to Submitted (one send only) and starts the process flow PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubReceiptValidation
jsclass.description: POST { lineid }: AI reads the receipt (PDF/image) and code checks it against the expense line. Saves the result on the receipt (1 line = 1 receipt).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestSend
jsclass.description: POST { id }: sends the employee's own DRAFT leave request for approval (status PENDING) and emails every user with role PeopleHubManagerTrainingME (template PeopleHubLeaveRequestApproval).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimApprovalPrepare
jsclass.description: Process flow PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval, step 1: summary of the claim (already Submitted by PeopleHubExpenseClaimSend) and its AI results, recommendation, approver emails.

jsclass.name: OnboardingReminder
jsclass.description: Job script: onboarding progress, overdue tasks and tasks due in the next 14 days, written to the log

jsclass.name: PeopleHubReceiptFile
jsclass.description: GET ?receiptid=: returns the receipt file as binary with its real Content-Type, shown inline. Use the URL as the source of sap.m.PDFViewer (PDF) or sap.m.Image (photos).

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestUser
jsclass.description: Returns the current user, their SAP employee (PERNR, name, manager) from peoplehubusermap + SAP, and the Cockpit roles PeopleHubEmployeeTrainingME / PeopleHubManagerTrainingME.

jsclass.name: PeopleHubLeaveRequestUserMapSeed
jsclass.description: Links each training participant (Neptune user name) to a SAP employee (PERNR) in peoplehubusermap. Checks the PERNR in SAP first. Run before the training; safe to run repeatedly.

jsscript_group.name: PeopleHubOnboarding
jsscript_group.description: Onboarding (exercises 1.2 and 5.2): the reminder job script

theme.name: PeopleHubBrand
theme.description: PeopleHub brand for the launchpad (exercise 4.0, reference)

pdf.description: PeopleHub leave approval confirmation (generated by PeopleHubLeaveRequestDecide)

reports.name: PeopleHubLeaveDaysByType
reports.description: Leave days by absence type (tile chart)

wf_notifications.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval
wf_notifications.description: Expense claim "{=title}" is waiting for your approval

script_scheduler.name: OnboardingReminder
script_scheduler.description: Daily onboarding reminder: progress, overdue tasks and tasks due in the next 14 days

ai_agent.name: PeopleHubInvoiceExtractionImage
ai_agent.description: Reads a receipt photo (JPG/PNG) and compares it with the claimed expense line. Returns JSON (see prompt). Called by script PeopleHubReceiptValidation.

ai_agent.name: PeopleHubInvoiceExtractionPDF
ai_agent.description: Reads a receipt PDF and compares it with the claimed expense line. Returns JSON (see prompt). Called by script PeopleHubReceiptValidation.

workflow.name: PeopleHubExpenseClaimApproval
workflow.description: Expense claim approval: started by script PeopleHubExpenseClaimSend (claim already Submitted) -> prepare -> email approvers -> user task (role PeopleHubApproverClaim) -> approve/reject -> email requester.
